openai.notes: OpenAI's own Terraform provider currently covers administration, not saved agents.

anthropic.notes: Community provider; destroy archives the agent.

grok.notes: The reviewed public API exposes Responses and tools, not saved-agent CRUD. Terraform does not execute inference.

mistral.notes: Beta Agents API; POST create, PATCH update, GET read, DELETE remove.

gemini.notes: Native ADK config deployment through the official Google provider; requires an existing project and runtime identity. This is Google Cloud runtime coverage, not every standalone Gemini developer-API agent feature.

bedrock.notes: Official provider coverage; use the native resource. No dedicated adapter in this repository.

azure_foundry.notes: Microsoft documents Microsoft.Foundry/agents@v1 using AzAPI >=2.9.0. No dedicated adapter in this repository.

muse.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Meta Model API. Model access can be preview/account dependent. Spark Open and Glimmer require a separate hosting endpoint; image/audio-specific APIs are outside this profile.

deepseek.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface. Preserve native reasoning_content and tool-call history in the application.

qwen.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Supply the workspace- and region-specific Model Studio base URL in options.base_url; credentials and model availability must match that region. No default region is chosen.

kimi.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. International Kimi API endpoint. Kimi Code subscriptions and regional endpoints can have different credentials and access.

glm.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Standard Z.ai API endpoint, not the dedicated GLM Coding Plan endpoint. ZAI_API_KEY is this adapter's runtime environment convention.

minimax.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. OpenAI-compatible text surface. MINIMAX_API_KEY is this adapter's runtime environment convention; direct OpenAI SDK use must pass its value explicitly. Preserve reasoning_content on subsequent tool turns.

cohere.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Cohere's compatibility API, not its native v2 Chat API. Supported settings and tools are limited by the compatibility surface.

nvidia.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Hosted NVIDIA API Catalog endpoint. This does not deploy a self-hosted NIM or guarantee every model accepts tools or a system prompt.

openrouter.notes: Portable definition and runtime request template; no inference execution or remote agent provisioning. Gateway inference, with author/model IDs supplied by the caller. The official OpenRouterTeam/openrouter Terraform provider manages platform administration, not saved agent definitions.
